title: Russia says responding to US report of planned attack on Moscow

blocks.text: MOSCOW — Russia’s FSB security service said on Saturday it was carrying out “appropriate” measures after the US embassy in Moscow warned of a planned “terrorist” attack in the capital. The US embassy said earlier it was “aware of a credible threat of a mass casualty event TODAY October 31, at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve in Moscow”. The US government was “coordinating with appropriate Russian authorities on a response,” it said, advising people: “Avoid the area, stay alert, and avoid crowds.” The US embassy did not give details on who was plotting the attack.
